summary: This stage conducted a thorough, read-only static audit of Paper P and its repository without downloading embeddings or re-executing cells. It successfully discovered key implementation discrepancies, including that the paper's grammatical classifier and reported 0.389 cosine similarity rely on LinearSVC rather than LDA (A7), that code for word similarity, translation, and Spearman correlation is missing (A15), that embedding and input assets are absent (A8), and that doPCA has an operator precedence bug in centering (A16). It also noted identical MWEAT statistics with diverging p-values (A1), identical Shift Ori and Hybrid Ori statistics (A3), the FR MWEAT saved-output disagreement (A4), noun-list data quality flaws (A9), and unnormalized dot products in MWEAT (A25). It missed the circularity of MWEAT mitigation evaluation (A2), masculine adjective cues in Table 2 (A5), and the inanimate bias score (A6), while asserting as established fact that the paper's written MWEAT equation contradicts the nested-absolute-value statistic (B1).
